source_note: Expert episode 36 (layout 16 / style 60). The executor could not reproduce the mug-handle grasp and release reliably (the handle is a C-shaped loop; a finger ends up inside the loop), so this demonstration is the expert recording itself with commands written as an approximate translation.
note: The mug stands in an open wall cabinet; the coffee machine sits on the counter below it. The expert grasped the mug by its HANDLE with the fingers forward (opening ~0.2) and pulled it out. Placing it: FIRST lower the mug to just above the drip tray while still in front of the machine (about 12 cm short of the dispenser), THEN slide it horizontally at that height under the dispenser, release, and back the fingers out. Then press the start button on the machine's front with the fingertips: a thin brown coffee stream appearing under the dispenser shows that the press worked; then move away. These commands are an approximate translation of a human recording, not re-executed.

turns.scene: Mug inside the open wall cabinet ahead, at about height 152; coffee machine on the counter below.
turns.plan: Raise the hand and tilt the fingers forward.

turns.scene: Fingers half-forward, near the body at height ~142.
turns.plan: Turn the fingers fully forward and rise to the mug's height.

turns.scene: Fingers forward at height ~153, in front of the cabinet.
turns.plan: Reach into the cabinet so the mug's handle sits between the fingers.
Pull the mug straight out of the cabinet and slightly down.

turns.scene: Mug out of the cabinet, close to the robot.
turns.plan: Lower the mug towards the machine's height, turning the hand.

turns.scene: Mug held by its handle, low in front of the coffee machine, about 25 cm short of the dispenser.
turns.plan: Lower the mug to just above the drip-tray height (about 15 cm above the counter) while still in FRONT of the machine, about 12 cm short of the dispenser, so it cannot hit the dispenser.

turns.scene: Mug just above the drip tray, about 12 cm in front of the dispenser and slightly to its left.
turns.plan: Slide the mug horizontally, at the same height, into the slot under the dispenser until it is centred below it.

turns.scene: Mug placed, gripper open around the handle.
turns.plan: Back the fingers out of the handle gently.
Rise to the height of the start button and turn the fingers forward again.

turns.scene: Fingertips in front of the machine's start button.
turns.plan: Push the start button with the fingertips until they touch it.

turns.scene: Button pressed: a thin brown coffee stream now falls from the dispenser into the mug, so the machine is on.
turns.plan: Move away from the button and the mug (the stream stays on).
